comparisons.comparison: Both MU and AMD disclose the specific interest rate margins applied to SOFR on their respective revolving credit facilities, though the specific margins and base rate structures differ. MU applies a margin of 1.00% to 1.75% to adjusted term SOFR (which includes a credit spread adjustment of 0.11% to 0.43%), while AMD applies a margin of 0.575% to 1.20% to SOFR. Both companies reported no outstanding borrowings under these facilities as of their respective fiscal year-end dates.

sentences.text: Under the Revolving Credit Facility, borrowings would generally bear interest at a rate equal to adjusted term SOFR plus 1.00% to 1.75%, depending on our corporate credit ratings.

Adjusted term SOFR for the Revolving Credit Facility agreement is the SOFR benchmark plus a credit spread adjustment ranging from approximately 0.11% to 0.43% depending on the applicable interest period selected.
As of December 28, 2024 and December 30, 2023, the Company had no outstanding borrowings under the Revolving Credit Agreement.
Each SOFR Loan will bear interest at a rate per annum equal to the applicable SOFR plus a margin between 0.575% and 1.20%.
